name: Projector Slideshow
description: Old-school projector slideshow where photos slide in with a quick sweep, with lens blur, light flicker and drifting dust motes over a framed screen.
contents: Framed projection screen showing one image at a time
Floating dust motes layered over the images
behavior: Advances to the next image on an interval with a fast slide and rotate transition
Image starts blurred and focuses shortly after mount
Dust motes spawn periodically and drift across the screen while fading
editableByProps: Images and alt text, slide timing and transition speed
Screen size, background, shadow and mote colors as Tailwind classes
Blur, flicker rate and dust mote timing

needsCodeEdit.where: The transform strings inside the images map

needsCodeEdit.change: Change mote size or opacity range
needsCodeEdit.where: createMote function inside the mote useEffect

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Renders an empty placeholder until mounted to avoid hydration mismatch
